messages:
hannah: Opening a docs PR after a customer hit a weird SELinux/PrivateTmp case: HSM plugin binds a unix socket in /tmp and redwood process can't open it on RHEL9 Enforcing. PR includes migration steps, systemd fragment, and air-gapped notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4888

mike.sre: can you paste the AVC denial so we capture the labels?

hannah: short audit line I pulled: `Jun 21 11:02:03 host audit[5678]: AVC avc:  denied  { open } for pid=5678 comm=\"redwood-hsm\" name=pkcs11.sock scontext=system_u:system_r:redwood_t:s0 tcontext=unconfined_u:object_r:tmp_t:s0 tclass=unix_stream_socket`

lucy.docs: TL;DR PrivateTmp causes tmp_t label; redwood_t cannot open tmp_t. Docs should recommend a persistent socket directory under /run or /var/lib with proper SELinux filecontext and show restorecon/semanage examples. Also add AppArmor note for Ubuntu.

packaging: packaging suggestion: ship a .fc fragment in the RPM and use `rpm --restorecon` in postinstall; that covers air-gapped installs without policycoreutils present. We'll include a `.fc` sample in the PR.

hannah: included a minimal migration script in PR that works offline (mv + chown + conditional restorecon):

`#!/bin/sh
OLD=/tmp/pkcs11.sock
NEW_DIR=/run/redwood/hsm
NEW=$NEW_DIR/pkcs11.sock
if [ -S "$OLD" ]; then
  systemctl stop redwood-hsm || true
  mkdir -p "$NEW_DIR"
  mv "$OLD" "$NEW"
  chown root:root "$NEW" || true
  if command -v restorecon >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    /sbin/restorecon -R "$NEW_DIR" || true
  fi
  systemctl start redwood-hsm || true
  echo "migrated $OLD -> $NEW"
else
  echo "no legacy socket found"
fi`

lucy.docs: add a short systemd override example that keeps PrivateTmp and uses RuntimeDirectory so socket lives under /run:
`[Service]
PrivateTmp=yes
RuntimeDirectory=redwood-hsm
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0755
ExecStartPre=/bin/mkdir -p /run/redwood/hsm
ExecStartPre=/usr/sbin/semanage fcontext -a -t var_run_t '/run/redwood/hsm(/.*)?' || true
ExecStartPre=/sbin/restorecon -R /run/redwood/hsm || true`

packaging: note in Advanced > SELinux: for minimal systems without semanage, show `chcon -t var_run_t /run/redwood/hsm` as fallback and explicitly state it may not survive full relabels. Keep semanage in Advanced only.

docs-bot: Link-check: PR 4888 failed  removed broken internal placeholder link to internal KB. Marked updated link for manual approval.

security-bot: Please do not advise `setenforce 0` or system-wide SELinux disable. Add an explicit "do not disable SELinux" bullet in Troubleshooting.

lucy.docs: done  added Troubleshooting bullet and short AppArmor note: for Ubuntu add `/run/redwood/hsm/*` to the redwood-hsm profile and reload with `apparmor_parser -r /etc/apparmor.d/usr.bin.redwood-hsm`.

hannah: I'll run a quick air-gapped smoke test on a RHEL9 VM and ping results here. Leaving thread open for any final copyedit/security tweaks.
